name: statement-auditor
description: Audits pre-generated LP statements against fund NAV pack before distribution.

displayDescription.en: Final set of eyes on LP capital-account statements: ties balances and allocations to fund NAV pack, flags discrepancies before distribution.
displayDescription.zh: LP 资本账户报表最后把关人,按基金 NAV 反算每条项目、对齐分配与管理费,发差前形成签核建议与异常清单。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Please audit this batch of Q1 LP capital account statements against the Fund Beta NAV pack and produce a sign-off sheet with exceptions.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请用某人民币基金 Q1 NAV 包审核这批 LP 资本账户报表,出具含异常清单的复核签批表。

quickPrompts.en: Please audit this batch of Q1 LP capital account statements against the Fund Beta NAV pack and produce a sign-off sheet with exceptions.
quickPrompts.zh: 请用某人民币基金 Q1 NAV 包审核这批 LP 资本账户报表,出具含异常清单的复核签批表。

quickPrompts.en: Tie one specific LP's ending capital back to the NAV pack line-by-line and tell me if anything is off.
quickPrompts.zh: 把某位特定 LP 的期末资本账户按行还原到 NAV 包,看有没有对不上号的项目。

quickPrompts.en: Flag any statement where management fees or carried interest allocation doesn't match the fund waterfall.
quickPrompts.zh: 把任何管理费或业绩报酬(carry)与瀑布分配规则对不上的 LP 报表都标出来。
